description: Ban up to 200 users at once by ID, for raid cleanup. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token performs the bans. Reports which bans succeeded and which failed.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

delete_message_seconds.description: Also delete each banned user's messages from this many seconds back, up to 604800 (7 days). Default 0, nothing deleted.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

reason.description: The reason recorded in the server's audit log.

name: bulk_ban
title: Bulk ban
